text.body: tridalaṃ triguṇākāraṃ triṇetraṃ ca triyāyudham । trijanmapāpasaṃhāram ekabilvaṃ śivārpaṇam ॥ 1॥ triśākairbilvapatraiśca acchidraiḥ komalaiśśubhaiḥ । tava pūjāṃ kariṣyāmi ekabilvaṃ śivārpaṇam ॥ 2॥ darśanaṃ bilvavṛkṣasya sparśanaṃ pāpanāśanam । aghorapāpasaṃhāram ekabilvaṃ śivārpaṇam ॥ 3॥ kāśīkṣetranivāsaṃ ca kālabhairavadarśanam । prayāge mādhavaṃ dṛṣṭvā ekabilvaṃ śivārpaṇam ॥ 4॥ tulasī bilvanirguṇḍī jaṃbīrāmalakaṃ tathā । pañcabilvamiti khyātā ekabilvaṃ śivārpaṇam ॥ 5॥ taṭākaṃ dhananikṣepaṃ brahmasthāpyaṃ śivālayam । koṭikanyāmahādānam ekabilvaṃ śivārpaṇam ॥ 6॥ dantyaśvakoṭidānāni aśvamedhaśatāni ca । koṭikanyāmahādānam ekabilvaṃ śivārpaṇam ॥ 7॥ sālagrāmasahasrāṇi viprānnaṃ śatakoṭikam । yajñakoṭisahasrāṇi ekabilvaṃ śivārpaṇam ॥ 8॥ ajñānena kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ jñānenāpi kṛtaṃ ca yat । tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyātu ekabilvaṃ śivārpaṇam ॥ 9॥ ekaikabilvapatreṇa koṭiyajñaphalaṃ labhet । mahādevasya pūjārtham ekabilvaṃ śivārpaṇam ॥ 10॥ amṛtodbhavavṛkṣasya mahādevapriyasya ca । mucyante kaṇṭakāghātā kaṇṭakebhyo hi mānavāḥ ॥ 11॥ ॥ oṃ tatsat ॥
